stops.note: 'to bend, bow', also the root of 'bow' and 'bight'
'pliant, obedient'; in the Sarum marriage rite the bride promised to be 'bonere and buxum in bedde and at borde'
passed through 'blithe, jolly' to 'plump and healthy', and later 'full-bosomed'

current_meaning: (of a woman) attractively plump and full-bosomed
